IndiGo Aircraft Collides With Pole at Srinagar Airport

An IndiGo aircraft made contact with a parking stand pole while maneuvering at Srinagar Airport. The incident occurred during parking, and no injuries were reported among the passengers or crew. The flight, identified as 6E 225 from Navi Mumbai, was involved. Authorities have been alerted and are examining the circumstances. The aircraft will undergo necessary maintenance.
